purpose: Freeze PH-D01A-admitted source content identity, acquisition provenance, replay environment identity, and run evidence as four separate contracts without trajectory normalization, semantic source parsing, source execution, or downstream causal work.

X.coordinate: Content, acquisition, environment, and run identity immediately after metadata-only source admission and before cross-schema canonicalization or trajectory normalization
inputs: PH-D01A checked source inventory and eight SourceProfile documents
fifty Git-tracked ARC3 environment source files and their distribution aliases
twenty-five pinned public human recording rows
exact Python, OS, dependency, and isolation observations
X.change_scope: PH-D01B manifest schemas, freeze plan, deterministic content/Merkle compiler, checked manifests and reports, tests, phase evidence, and isolated distillation documentation only.

R.risk: Path- or timestamp-dependent content identity, an unverified remote recording, incomplete wheel or environment binding, mutable source handling, or mixed content/acquisition/run metadata would make every downstream trajectory and causal artifact irreproducible.
R.required_response: Fail closed on source-inventory drift, unpinned or mismatched remote content, invalid POSIX paths, duplicate paths, file hash or size drift, Merkle mismatch, wheel mismatch, dependency drift, source mutation, acquisition fields entering content identity, environment incompleteness, or any downstream-phase claim.
R.claim_boundary: PH_D01B_MANIFEST_FREEZE_PASS may establish source and environment identity only. ARC3_TEACHER_SOURCE_FROZEN requires all PH-D01A/B exit conditions and does not establish trajectory normalization, causal evidence, Rule promotion, Bridge readiness, AGI capability, or official readiness.

Mc.mechanism: Strict JSON contracts, repository-relative POSIX locators, byte-level SHA-256 and size records, domain-separated directory Merkle roots, separately digested acquisition/run metadata, authority-bound wheel and interpreter records, pinned read-only Dataset Viewer acquisition, pre/post source snapshots, and deterministic checked-report reconstruction.
Mc.owner_authority: 大平鉄兵 remains the sole Rule, promotion, bundle, locked-final, official, and submission decision authority.
Mc.rollback: Revert PH-D01B-owned commits only; preserve all source bytes, external archives, pre-existing P22/CV worktree changes, and prior phase evidence.

scope: define strict SourceContentManifest, AcquisitionRecord, EnvironmentManifest, and RunManifest schemas
freeze one SourceContentManifest for each of the eight PH-D01A profiles
hash five ARC2 archive-member payloads and verify their authority digests
hash fifty repository ARC3 environment files and prove their archive aliases are byte-identical
hash three repository canonical teacher-corpus files
verify twenty-five pinned raw recording trajectory hashes against the pinned public dataset revision or fail closed
bind arc_agi 0.9.8 and arcengine 0.9.3 wheel payload hashes and sizes
bind exact Python, implementation, OS, architecture, dependencies, seed/reset defaults, and source-isolation state
separate local path, acquisition time, mtime, actor, transport, command, start, and end fields from logical content identity
produce deterministic source-freeze and environment-isolation reports
prove path/time independence, source-mutation invalidation, Merkle completeness, environment completeness, and non-mutation
non_goals: PH-D02A repository-wide canonical serialization and packaging contract
copying external ARC archives or raw recordings into the repository
semantic parsing of ARC2 task JSON or ARC3 trajectories
Causal IR, HypothesisIR, candidate generation, exact fit, or intervention
test_contract: DG-00 source inventory, content manifests, environment manifest, and phase coordinate are mutually bound
DG-06 every admitted source has verified content identity or an explicit blocking failure
DG-12 archive, remote call, interpreter, dependency, source-access, and write boundaries are explicit
content digest is independent of local path, acquisition timestamp, and mtime
source byte mutation changes file digest, Merkle root, content digest, and downstream environment binding
repository paths are normalized relative POSIX paths with traversal and absolute paths rejected
directory Merkle roots domain-separate path, size, and content digest and cover every expected entry exactly once
ARC2 authority member digests and ARC3 authority wheel digests match
all fifty ARC3 archive environment aliases match the repository source bytes
all twenty-five raw recording trajectory hashes match the pinned source selection
manifest compilation does not import, execute, replay, or semantically parse source payloads
source pre/post byte snapshots are identical
checked reports rebuild byte-identically three times
PH-D02A, normalization, Causal IR, candidate, Bridge, runtime, official, and Kaggle counts remain zero
dod: eight SourceContentManifest documents cover all eighty-three admitted source IDs exactly once
same content acquired at another path or time has the same content digest
mtime and created_at changes do not alter content digest
ARC3 replay environment hash completely binds fifty source files, two wheels, interpreter, OS, dependencies, and isolation contract
stop_conditions: a required source content value cannot be retrieved from a revision-bound source
an authority digest or archive alias mismatches
environment identity cannot be made complete without entering a later phase
the implementation would require semantic payload parsing or source execution
the Work Block would cross a hard gate or phase boundary
expected_outputs: separate AcquisitionRecord, EnvironmentManifest, and RunManifest documents
PH-D01B Phase State and evidence package
